author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/43-federation.md — full design doc.

## What this epic delivers
Cross-instance ATProto-native federation of moderation escalations. A community labeler can escalate to Bluesky (or peer-to-peer) and the conversation flows over the same ATProto sync infrastructure v1 already uses for the firehose. Privacy boundary: instance identities federate, moderator identities do not.

## Hard dependency
Blocked by #99 (M5 #42 NSIDs epic). The wire format (`polaris.escalation`, `polaris.escalation-message`) is defined there — federation cannot transport state until those lexicons exist.

## Sub-issues
- Q-resolution: confirm 5 open design decisions (Q1 transport, Q2 trust model, Q3 conflict resolution, Q4 context level, Q5 withdrawal semantics)
- PR 1: peer firehose subscription + quarantine table (read-only)
- PR 2: federation state machine + 4 new tables + state-transition audit log
- PR 3: outbound publish + `polaris federation-escalate` admin command + privacy-boundary enforcement
- PR 4: bidirectional escalation-message records + case-view cross-instance thread UI
- PR 5: `polaris federation-status` admin command + federation health metrics + signature-failure alerting
- PR 6: two-instance fixture network integration tests covering AC-1 through AC-8

## Provisional answers
- Q1: A (firehose-subscription via proto-blue). Reuses ATProto sync infra; latency is seconds, not subsecond, which is fine for a moderator conversation.
- Q2: A (pairwise allowlist). Operator declares each peer DID explicitly. Forward-compatible — schema allows richer trust later.
- Q3: A (surface-only). Each instance keeps its own labels; cross-instance disagreements visible via existing v1 upstream-label observation pipeline. Silent override of a local moderation decision is wrong.
- Q4: B (escalation + subject DID + free-text reasoning + snapshot of public observations). Public-derived observations are not a privacy leak; report metadata + reporter identities are, so those stay local.
- Q5: A (withdrawal marks the peer's view as `WithdrawnBySource` and locks further state transitions; no destructive operations across boundaries).

## Rust-quality notes for any downstream implementer
- **State machine is explicit**, not implicit. Per design REQ-7: states are `Proposed`, `Acknowledged`, `Active`, `Resolved`, `WithdrawnBySource`, `RejectedByTarget`. Encode as a typestate where possible (per rust-quality §2 — typestate prevents invalid transitions at compile time): `Escalation<Proposed>`, `Escalation<Acknowledged>`, etc. The fallback (if typestate over async boundaries proves awkward) is a runtime enum with an exhaustive `match` at every transition site + a `tracing::error!` on the unreachable arm.
- **Signature verification at the federation boundary** uses the same `proto-blue-crypto` K-256 primitives v1 uses for upstream labels (`polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs` is the reference impl). Don't introduce a parallel verify path.
- **Idempotency is by record CID.** Every federated record has an ATProto CID; replay-on-reconnect uses `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (cid) DO NOTHING`. The case store enforces uniqueness; the federation layer does not need its own dedup.
- **The privacy boundary lives in the mapping layer (#99/#103).** Federation code reads `polaris_lexicons::EscalationMessage` (already-stripped wire shape); it never sees `polaris_types::EscalationMessage` directly. The privacy enforcement is the mapping function, not a federation-layer scrub.
- **`tokio::select!` cancel-safety:** the per-peer `Firehose` reconnect loop must be cancel-safe across all branches per rust-quality §10. Pin futures outside the `select!` and pass `&mut fut` in.
- **Per-peer task isolation:** one `tokio::task::JoinSet` per peer DID. A misbehaving peer's task crashes its own set, never the whole federation worker. Use `CancellationToken` for graceful shutdown — `spawn_blocking` cannot be aborted.

## External references
- ATProto federation primitives: https://atproto.com/guides/federation
- proto-blue Firehose abstraction (v1 reference): `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue/src/repo.rs`
- v1 firehose ingest (in-repo reference impl): `polaris-backend/src/ingest/firehose.rs`
- v1 upstream-labels signature verify (reference): `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs`
- `tokio::JoinSet` for per-peer task isolation: https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/task/struct.JoinSet.html

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #99 (NSIDs epic).
- Soft-related to #112 epic (trust model — once cross-instance labels exist, the trust model has more work to do; the interaction is captured in trust-model epic).
